description: This file contains the definition of the SearchWrapper class within the SuiteCRM project. It manages different search engine implementations, facilitates search operations, and handles configuration and module management related to search functionalities.

classes.name: SearchWrapper
classes.description: A class providing a unified interface to perform search operations using various search engines like Elasticsearch, Lucene, and Basic Search within SuiteCRM. It supports dynamically adding engines, retrieving default and available engines, configuration management, and performing searches with different engines.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search based on the provided SearchQuery object and displays the results using the selected or default search engine.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query with a specified engine and returns the SearchResults, grouping results by module.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Registers a new search engine class by name, file path, and fully qualified class name.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns a list of available search engine class names, including default and custom engines.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the default search engine name from the global configuration, or falls back to the first registered engine.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the configured search controller from the SugarCRM configuration.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules enabled for search.

methods.name: getModulesForDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves enabled modules with their display labels for search configuration.

methods.name: getUserSelectedModules
methods.description: Gets the list of modules selected by the current user for search, respecting previous preferences.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Validates and retrieves an instance of the specified search engine, supporting subclass validation and dynamic inclusion of custom engines.

methods.name: getSearchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves specific search-related configuration parameters from the SugarCRM global settings.
